## Summary

Describe the user-visible or engineering change and its motivation.

## Validation

- [ ] `uv run ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run mypy src`
- [ ] `uv run pytest`
- [ ] Migration impact was reviewed and a migration was added when needed.
- [ ] Security, permissions, secrets, and personal-data impact were reviewed.

## Review notes

- PR titles must follow **Conventional Commits**, for example `feat(api): add import preview`.
- Link relevant issues and call out any intentionally deferred follow-up.
